name: Frame clock
responsibility: The one clock that glides, picture transitions and subtitle lingers read: the browser's own on a live page, a stepped one on a replay
description: A replay swaps it once, before it mounts anything. Its stepped clock runs frame callbacks and timers at their due times, and takes over the browser's own requestAnimationFrame, so a library's frames run on it too. It pauses and stands every Web Animation and CSS transition at the frame's time, a picture's traffic at where its picture's clock stands, and records a violation for an animation on a timeline it cannot stand. A lint rule keeps the viewer and the subtitles on it.
